admission.justification: Heading Architect weighed raising three base ceilings against explicit additive appendix allowances, and the chosen allowances govern the Phase 1 wire-token gate until Phase 2 ceilings replace them.

alternatives.option: Option A: Keep the eight D976 Q5 Phase 1 base ceilings unchanged for bare launches and add explicit appendix allowances (PHASE_1_HELD_APPENDIX_ALLOWANCE=600 for held reviewer/curator openings, PHASE_1_LAUNCH_APPENDIX_ALLOWANCE=900 for direct worker launches with appendices).
alternatives.reason: Preserves the D976 Q5 bare-launch ceilings without weakening them while explicitly bounding the additive ordinary-Latin appendix populations enforced by settings.role_message_limit.

alternatives.option: Option B: Raise the three leaf base ceilings in PHASE_1_WIRE_TOKEN_CEILINGS to absorb the appendix tokens inside the bare ceiling.
alternatives.reason: Raising base ceilings weakens non-ratcheting enforcement on bare default launches that carry no appendix.
alternatives.reconsider_when: When CAP-L3 replaces Phase 1 wire-token ceilings with Phase 2 ceilings or removes the separate appendix allowance model.

consequences: All eight bare default launch pairs remain bounded by unchanged D976 Q5 ceilings; opened held reviewer/curator prompts are bounded by base + 600 tokens and direct worker launches with appendices by base + 900 tokens, enforced by wire_budget.evaluate_wire_token_ceilings and test_role_wire_token_budgets.py.
context: During CAP-L2 Round 1 review (CAPL2-RV-01/02), opened held reviewer and curator prompts and direct worker launches carrying required bounded appendices (successor, step-up, ACP, and 1,000-character ordinary-Latin opening or held previews) exceeded bare D976 Q5 Phase 1 base ceilings while default bare launches remained under ceiling.
decider: Heading Architect (seat 9bec7b58) Option A ruling recorded in renewed CAP-R02@v1 manifest (corpus_digest 5017a0b8)
